name: Screen Watcher
creator: Joshua Ferguson
desc: Background watcher: alerts (ntfy, Discord, Pushover, Home Assistant) when the target loses video, blue-screens, goes black or freezes.

CHECK_S.label: Check every (seconds)
CHECK_S.description: 15 to 3600. Each check briefly uses one CPU core (about 1.5 s at 1080p).

SIGNAL_GRACE_S.label: Signal-loss grace (seconds)
SIGNAL_GRACE_S.description: Alert when video has been gone this long (after having been seen)

BSOD_ALERT.label: Blue-screen alert
BSOD_ALERT.description: true/false. Turn off if your desktop or wallpaper is mostly blue

BLACK_MIN.label: Black-screen alert (minutes)
BLACK_MIN.description: 0 = off. Alert when the screen stays black (with signal) this long

FREEZE_MIN.label: Frozen-screen alert (minutes)
FREEZE_MIN.description: 0 = off. Alert when nothing changes on screen this long

HA_WEBHOOK_URL.label: Home Assistant webhook URL
HA_WEBHOOK_URL.description: http(s)://<ha>/api/webhook/<id>; payload has title, message, level, device
